Name: Simple Mastery Expansion
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b][size=5]Simple Mastery Expansion[/size][/b]
[b]Grow beyond level 10 with a new perk at every level, stronger late-game rewards, and skill progression up to level 30.[/b]
Simple Mastery Expansion adds [b]150 level rewards[/b] across Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining and Combat. Bonuses start at level 1, so progression feels rewarding throughout your save.


Progression
Reach [b]level 10 in all five skills[/b] to unlock levels 11–30. You do not need Mastery level 5 or the cave rewards.
Perks activate automatically as you level. Your normal profession choices remain, with additional choices at [b]levels 15, 20, 25 and 30[/b] that let you select professions you do not already own.

Skill rewards

[list]
[*][b]Farming:[/b] Fertilizer refunds, extra crops, seasonal fertilizer retention and improved crop quality. Growth reduction increases through [b]4%, 8%, 12%, 16% and 20%[/b]. At level 30, gain a [b]25% extra-crop chance[/b] and a [b]7% non-Deluxe iridium-quality upgrade chance[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Fishing:[/b] Faster bites, tackle protection and reduced catch-progress loss. Reach [b]50% shorter bite waits at level 20[/b], then a [b]+16-pixel fishing bar[/b] and [b]33% chance to double eligible catches at level 30[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Foraging:[/b] More tree seeds, up to [b]50% extra wood and hardwood[/b], and additional seasonal forage. Level 30 grants [b]one guaranteed matching forage copy[/b], plus a [b]25% chance for a different eligible local seasonal forage[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Mining:[/b] More ore and stone, reduced damage from your own bombs and improved ladder chances. Level 30 grants [b]one guaranteed extra ore plus a 25% chance for another[/b], alongside [b]+200% stone—triple the normal yield[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Combat:[/b] More monster loot, extra health, faster melee attacks and shorter special-attack cooldowns. The loot bonus reaches a [b]20% extra normal drop-table roll at level 15[/b]. Level 30 totals include [b]+40 health[/b], [b]20% shorter special cooldowns[/b] and [b]3 HP restored on eligible melee kills[/b].[/*]
[/list]Clear skill details

Browse all 30 levels in a scrollable panel showing [b]Reward[/b] and [b]Effect[/b], including cumulative totals, current bonuses and XP progress. Supports mouse scrolling, a draggable scrollbar and controller navigation.
Includes all [b]12 built-in game languages[/b].

Settings and compatibility

Optional [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] settings let each farmer toggle Mariner, Agriculturist, Perfect Cultivation and the new crop-growth bonus without removing earned rewards.
Existing levels, XP, professions and pending choices are preserved. Vanilla Mastery Cave rewards remain unchanged.

[b]Please note:[/b]
[list]
[*]Growth bonuses apply to newly planted crops, follow native rounding and do not shorten regrow intervals.[/*]
[*]Fish doubling excludes ponds, boss fish, quest items and flagged one-time catches.[/*]
[*]Bonus drops do not trigger themselves repeatedly, and perks have no daily caps.[/*]
[*]Other mods that replace the same gameplay mechanics may need compatibility support.[/*]
[/list]
Installation
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.4+[/b].
Extract [b]SimpleMasteryExpansion[/b] into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder. GMCM is optional. Multiplayer players should use the same version; live multiplayer compatibility remains unverified.
